role: Gate: replays the oracle's HarvestProbe cases (block, meta, held item with Efficiency, Haste, Mining Fatigue, onGround) through csrc/engine/harvest.c and compares canHarvestBlock, getCurrentPlayerStrVsBlock, getPlayerRelativeBlockHardness and block hardness bit for bit.

structs.name: case_rec
structs.java: one HarvestProbe case record (61 bytes in cases.bin)

notes: Test harness, built with -Dmain=gate_test_main behind tests/input_guard.c; not linked into the product and never on the tick path. make -C csrc test runs it on every directory under out/java/harvest. Native calls: can_harvest_block, block_hardness, player_str_vs_block, player_relative_block_hardness (csrc/engine/harvest.h), BLOCKS table. Skipped probe cases (water in the way, above y 255) are counted, not compared. Oracle side: oracle/harness/netherite/oracle/HarvestProbe.java. Recordings: out/java/harvest/seed2, seed42. ItemTool/EnchantmentHelper member names are inferred from what getCurrentPlayerStrVsBlock reads, not verified.
